Meet Destin — founder

Destin spent about 13 years in industrial coatings — blasting and painting, containment work, traveling job to job — and holds OSHA 10, C7, and C12. He knows what a crew actually needs because he was the crew. Now he runs Dismukes Recruiting: workers tell us their trade, see the real pay and per diem up front, and get matched — that's the whole journey, no games. And yes, DD up in the big live 3D stage is his guy — kind, playful, and always reminding you about that Alaska or Las Vegas trip at 500.

1. Tell us your trade

Email your name, your trade, where you live, and when you can start. Blasters, painters, shipyard, construction, healthcare, driving, warehouse, office — all fields welcome.

2. See the real pay first

Pay and per diem are stated up front on every job we send you. No surprises after you get there.

3. Get matched

When a job fits your trade and travel range, we put you forward. Applying never costs you anything.

Getting to the job — crew bus & truck

Crews get to work different ways — some ride a crew bus, some ride with the crew in the truck. Here is DD's truck and a crew bus together in 3D, headlights on, ready to roll out.

The 3D crew bus & truck view could not start on this device (WebGL unavailable) — no picture is being substituted. The ride note below still explains how crews get to the job.

Honest word on rides: transport depends on the employer and the job. Some jobs run a crew bus, some don't — we state how you'll get there up front, before you travel, same as pay and per diem. No bus company, schedule, or ride is promised here.

DD joke: Why did DD bring a ladder to the job fair? Heard the pay was going up. He still checked the per diem first — DD ain't nobody's fool.

Using DD, the truck & Brainstorm

  • Ask DD — tap “Ask DD — Dismukes Assistant” under the big 3D stage at the top of the Clubhouse and tap a question; he answers in text.
  • DD guide, the whole time — a 3D DD rides along at the bottom-right of your screen and his 3D truck at the bottom-left, wherever you scroll. From right there you can open his guide walk, hear a joke, wave back, change his outfit, or start the truck ride.
  • Jokes & outfits, anywhere — “Tell a joke” (under the big stage, or on the bottom-corner guide) cracks a text joke in DD's bubble; “Outfit” on the guide cycles his gear — Blast & Paint, Construction, Healthcare, Driving, General — and every 3D DD on the page changes with it.
  • Hear DD — in the Clubhouse, Play/Stop for Destin's own recorded voice. Nothing plays by itself.
  • Wave / Vine swing / Ride — the buttons under the big 3D stage make DD wave, swing on the vine, and ride the truck across; outfits in the Clubhouse change his gear per trade.
  • Truck ride — “Take a ride” under the 3D stage (or the Truck ride button in the Clubhouse) runs the full ride: the truck drives across to DD, he gets in, and it carries him clear across the stage.
  • Brainstorm Ideas — the green edge tab opens the ideas panel; ideas stay on this page while it's open.

Start here — all topics

Every topic from the full menu, in one place. Each one points you to the part of the site that handles it.

Start Here

New here? Start with the Help section — applying free, posting a job, and entering the giveaway, in plain words.

Apprenticeships

Learning a trade while you work it. Tell us your field in the Jobs section and ask what entry-level openings fit.

Job Fairs

When a fair or hiring event comes up, it is announced on this page and in the Hot Jobs list — subscribing is free for workers.

Youth & First Jobs

First job? Start in Jobs: your name, where you live, and when you can start is all you need to apply free.

Training

Some employers train on the job and some want experience first — we state what a post requires up front, before you travel.

For Workers

Workers always apply free. Pay and per diem are stated up front on every job we send you. See Jobs.

Paycheck Math

Read the hourly pay and the per diem together before you say yes — both are printed right on each posting here, no guessing.

Afford This Job?

A traveling job only works if the pay and per diem cover the road. That is why both numbers are printed up front on this site.

Travel Buddies

Crews often travel together to the same job. Mention your crew when you apply and we will note it with your application.

Safety Checklist

DD’s rules for blast & paint: don’t eat the paint chips, don’t blast the whole thing up, and wear your PPE every time.

Verified Pay Check

The pay on a posting is the pay as printed by the employer — check it on the card before you apply, and ask us if anything looks off.

Fresh Stories

News from the board and the giveaway is posted on this page — the subscriber count at the top is the verified real count.

Worker Win

A worker getting matched to a real job at the printed pay — that is the win this whole site is built for.

Crews Together

Applying as a crew? Email us together with each person’s name and trade, and we will put you forward together.

Per-Diem & Costs

Per diem is printed on the posting — for example, the Newport News bulletin above shows $140/day per diem for non-local candidates.

Donations

No automatic recurring donation is set up — every donation is a one-time gift you send yourself, only when you choose to.

Straight talk about donations: donations go directly to Dismukes Recruiting. Dismukes Recruiting is NOT a nonprofit, and donations are NOT tax-deductible. Donations do not go to a charity — no charity is involved in this donation section.

Want to give? Email us and we will walk you through it — one time, only when you choose to.
